visual_requirements.description: benevolent beautiful Hindu goddess with fair complexion, one head two arms two legs, fully opaque red and walnut sari, a plain trident in one hand and lotus in other
No outward supernatural emission; documented supernatural power earned through austere penance is conveyed by resolve, action, water and light
cold winter mountain water, with Mount Kailash behind as contextual home setting

source_claims.quote: Because Shiva could not easily be distracted from his yogic meditation, Parvati subjected herself to extreme acts of physical deprivation—such as meditating in cold water during the winter—to gain supernatural powers and win over the celibate god.

statement.id: Parvati menjalani tapa berat untuk memperoleh kekuatan dan memikat Siwa yang sedang bertapa.
statement.en: Parvati performed severe asceticism to gain power and win over the meditating Shiva.

source_claims.quote: After the marriage, Parvati moves to Mount Kailash, the residence of Shiva. To them are born Kartikeya (also known as Skanda and Murugan) – the leader of celestial armies, and Ganesha – the god of wisdom that prevents problems and removes obstacles.

statement.id: Setelah menikah, Parvati pindah ke Gunung Kailash, kediaman Siwa; dari mereka lahir Kartikeya (Skanda, Murugan), pemimpin pasukan langit, dan Ganesha, dewa kebijaksanaan penghalau rintangan.
statement.en: After the marriage Parvati moves to Mount Kailash, Shiva's residence; to them are born Kartikeya (Skanda, Murugan), leader of celestial armies, and Ganesha, god of wisdom who removes obstacles.

source_claims.quote: Parvati, the gentle aspect of Devi Shakti, is usually represented as fair, beautiful, and benevolent.

statement.id: Parvati, aspek lembut Dewi Shakti, biasanya digambarkan berkulit cerah, cantik, dan baik hati.
statement.en: Parvati, the gentle aspect of Devi Shakti, is usually represented as fair, beautiful, and benevolent.

source_claims.quote: These hands may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, bell, dish, goad, sugarcane stalk, or flowers (such as a lotus).

statement.id: Tangan Parvati dapat memegang trisula, cermin, tasbih, lonceng, piring, tongkat penggiring gajah, batang tebu, atau bunga seperti teratai.
statement.en: Parvati's hands may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, bell, dish, goad, sugarcane stalk, or flowers such as a lotus.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
